description: This file defines the DispatcherInterface interface in the Slim Framework, specifying methods for dispatching requests and retrieving allowed HTTP methods for a URI.

classes.name: DispatcherInterface
classes.description: An interface that declares methods for dispatching HTTP requests and fetching allowed methods for a given URI in the Slim Framework.

methods.name: dispatch
methods.description: Retrieves routing results for a given request method and URI.

methods.name: getAllowedMethods
methods.description: Returns an array of allowed HTTP methods for a specific URI.
